description: "The Study of Celtic Literature" by Matthew Arnold is a collection of lectures on the understanding and appreciation of Celtic literary heritage, likely written in the late 19th century. The text serves as an exploration of Celtic literature's richness and complexity, addressing how these works can resonate with broader cultural and literary discussions.
